records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Willow Studio set up
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero customer replies to three Wrenfield touches (email:34707538, email:1db4f2b8, email:580c23c0) despite a held welcome call (calendar:4f4e1424). No project, no invite, no tickets, 8 days left on Starter. Silence after a call plus three nudges suggests low self-serve momentum.

draft.subject: Getting Willow Studio's first project going
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for making time for the welcome call last week. I know the first weeks get busy, so I don't want setup to stall out on you.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the simplest starting point is one real project your team is already running. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
